senses.sense_definition: A feeling of strong dislike, hostility, or ill will toward someone or something.

examples.text: There is a long history of <w>animus</w> between the two neighboring countries.
The politician tried to hide his personal <w>animus</w> during the televised debate.

senses.sense_definition: The underlying spirit, motivation, or driving force behind a person's actions.

examples.text: The <w>animus</w> behind his artistic work is a deep desire for social change.
We must understand the <w>animus</w> that drives such radical political movements.

senses.sense_definition: The specific intent or purpose behind a legal action or decision.

examples.text: The court examined the <w>animus</w> of the defendant when the contract was signed.
Proving the <w>animus</w> of the corporation is essential for this specific legal case.

senses.sense_definition: In Jungian psychology, the unconscious masculine aspect of a woman's personality.

examples.text: Jung argued that every woman must integrate her <w>animus</w> to achieve psychological wholeness.
The concept of the <w>animus</w> is central to understanding the feminine psyche in analytical psychology.
